title: Plural of one-syllable diphthong words
focus: For these one-syllable diphthong words, drop the first vowel and add -ita/-itä: työ (“work”) → töitä.

exercises.prompt: Choose the plural partitive of työ (“work”).
exercises.explanation: Drop y from yö and add -itä: työ → töitä. This is the plural partitive of työ (“work”).
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Plural of one-syllable diphthong words: form or use confused
